reason: The text, which is Genesis 12:1-9 from the Masoretic Text, describes God's call to Abram and his obedient journey to Canaan with his household (Sarai, Lot, and their acquired servants). There is no depiction of antagonism between regular people and any leader. Rather, the passage shows unified departure and obedience: Abram responds to divine command without resistance, and those with him (Lot, servants, possessions) are portrayed as accompanying him without recorded conflict. The only mention of external people (the Canaanites) simply notes their presence in the land without any antagonistic interaction.
